subject: general
question: In which type of Megalith (grave/memorial) were the stone pieces set in a circular shape around the grave?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cairn circle.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• A **megalith** is a** big prehistoric stone** that has been utilized, either** alone or in conjunction **with other stones, to build a **structure or monument.**
 
• The** prehistoric stone row, or cairn-circles**, is a straight line of** parallel megalithic **standing stones.
 
• **250 cairn circles** have recently been identified by the **State Department of Archaeology **in **Chennai **from the **Kodumanal excavation site** in Tamil Nadu.
 
• The discovery of **10 pots and bowls **from the site, which were positioned outside of **three-chambered burial cists** and inside the cairn circle, is a first.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dolmen:**

 
 
• A dolmen or** portal tomb** is a form of the **single-chamber megalithic tomb,** usually consisting of two or more upright megaliths supporting a massive flat **horizontal capstone or "table".**
 
 
 
• **Rock cut cave:**
 
 
• A kind of rock art known as rock-cut architecture involves carving a building out of a** piece of solid, uncut rock.**
 
 
 
• **Menhir:**
 
 
• A menhir is a **huge upright stone **that was set in the ground by humans and is thought to have originated in **Europe during** the** middle Bronze Age.**
